d358a5adf4014da6.description: About the Role WSP Middle East is seeking a Construction Manager Assistant to join their team in Tabuk and Umluj. This full-time position involves supporting the site construction management and supervision of a high-end luxury hospitality development. The successful candidate will assist the Construction Manager in overseeing contractor activities, coordinating multidisciplinary works, and ensuring project adherence to quality and safety standards. Key Responsibilities Support the Construction Manager in the daily supervision and management of site activities. Monitor contractor and subcontractor works to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and project requirements. Supervise civil, structural, architectural, finishing, and associated building works. Coordinate with MEP, infrastructure, utilities, landscaping, and other project disciplines to resolve site interfaces. Monitor construction progress against the approved programme and highlight delays, constraints, and potential risks. Attend site inspections, coordination meetings, progress meetings, and technical discussions. Review and coordinate shop drawings, method statements, RFIs, material submissions, and other construction-related documentation. Support the Construction Manager in resolving technical and construction issues on site. Monitor workmanship and quality and assist with the identification and close-out of NCRs, site observations, and snagging items. Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, consultants, inspectors, and other project stakeholders. Support testing, commissioning, snagging, handover, and project close-out activities. Ensure contractor activities comply with project health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements. Prepare and contribute to daily/weekly progress reports and escalate key site issues to the Construction Manager. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, or a related discipline. 8–12 years of overall construction experience. Consultant/PMC construction supervision experience is required. Strong site-based experience on building projects. Experience in Saudi Arabia is strongly preferred. Experience on luxury hospitality, hotels, resorts, palaces, high-end residential, commercial, or mixed-use developments is highly advantageous. Required Skills Good exposure to structural, architectural, and finishing works, with an understanding of MEP and infrastructure interfaces. Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site coordination, quality inspections, and contractor management. Ability to review construction drawings and identify coordination or constructability issues. Good communication and stakeholder-management skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Tabuk and Umluj, focusing on a high-end luxury hospitality development project.

d3668e09cbedc3c5.description: About ABB ABB is a global technology company that helps industries operate more efficiently and sustainably. The company's Service Division collaborates with customers to enhance the availability, reliability, predictability, and sustainability of electrical products and installations. This includes offering product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime, and achieve operational and sustainable efficiency. The Role ABB is seeking a Field Service Engineer to join its team in Makkah, covering Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves executing service work of low to medium complexity according to work instructions, ABB standard processes, quality standards, and safety guidelines. The Field Service Engineer will plan and execute work with a first-time right approach, demonstrating a clear understanding of urgency and care in their area of responsibility. Key Responsibilities Execute service work with low to medium complexity in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards, and safety guidelines. Deliver quality customer service to ensure customer satisfaction. Handle medium and low voltage systems and switchgear installation, testing, and commissioning. Program and test protection relays. Execute service work as per customer orders and timelines. Prepare material lists and ensure the availability and quality of parts and equipment. Perform on-site and remote field service tasks, identify and resolve technical issues, and troubleshoot equipment/process failures. Recommend corrective actions and proactively suggest improvements to prevent future issues. Work directly with customers on-site to identify operational improvements and address pain points. Prepare all necessary documentation and customer reports for signature. Utilize all relevant tools and test equipment. Apply safety rules and practices during service activities, report unsafe practices and incidents, and ensure all work complies with safety standards and customer expectations. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to execute service work according to established instructions and standards. Proficiency in handling medium and low voltage systems and switchgear. Experience in programming and testing protection relays. Strong troubleshooting skills for technical issues and equipment failures. Ability to interact directly with customers and prepare comprehensive documentation. Commitment to safety rules and compliance in all service activities. Work Environment The team at ABB fosters a collaborative environment where members support each other, learn continuously, and work together to solve problems. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects that drive progress.

d33de6aea37b72d8.description: About MOZN MOZN is an Enterprise AI company focused on enabling organizations to make informed decisions in financial crime prevention and enterprise knowledge intelligence. The company fosters a collaborative environment, aiming to build AI that delivers business value, builds trust, and empowers organizations with augmented intelligence. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Role of Creative Design & Motion Specialist MOZN is seeking a Creative Design & Motion Specialist to develop visual experiences that enhance the MOZN brand and support business objectives. This role involves designing high-impact creative assets from concept to execution and bringing these designs to life through motion graphics and animation across various channels, including campaigns, events, social media, digital platforms, executive communications, and product marketing. The ideal candidate will possess strong graphic and visual design capabilities combined with hands-on motion graphics and animation expertise, with 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Develop creative concepts and design high-quality assets for digital campaigns, social media, email campaigns, presentations, web, product marketing, and executive communications. Create strong visual compositions using typography, layout, imagery, illustration, and brand elements. Bring original static designs and creative assets to life through motion graphics and animation for various platforms. Produce engaging explainer videos that simplify complex AI, compliance, and financial crime prevention topics. Design visual experiences for industry conferences, executive roundtables, customer events, and product launches. Lead creative projects from initial concept through final design and motion execution. Provide creative direction and guidance to designers and creative contributors as needed. Leverage modern design and AI-powered creative tools to accelerate ideation, content creation, design workflows, and production. Required Qualifications and Skills 2-5 years of experience in creative design and motion graphics. Demonstrated ability to independently develop visual concepts and creative assets, then translate them into compelling motion experiences. Previous experience leading creative projects, mentoring designers, or managing creative/design teams. Ability to provide creative direction and maintain high standards of design quality. Proficiency in transforming complex enterprise AI concepts into engaging visual content. Strong understanding of brand consistency and visual identity evolution across channels. Experience in managing multiple creative projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Application Requirements Applicants are required to submit a portfolio showcasing their creative design and motion graphics work. The portfolio should demonstrate original graphic and visual design, motion graphics and animation, the ability to design creative assets and bring them to life through motion, brand and campaign design, social media and digital marketing assets, presentation and visual storytelling examples, and preferably event, experiential, or product marketing creative. Applications without a portfolio or work samples will not be considered.

d3b8acd974d1e6a5.description: About the Role Jumeirah is seeking an Environment & Sustainability Executive to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the development and implementation of environmental and sustainability initiatives for the property, focusing on operational efficiency and compliance with relevant standards and regulations. Key Responsibilities Support the development and implementation of the property's environmental and sustainability strategy, policies, and initiatives. Monitor and report electricity, water, gas, and other utility consumption, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for reduction. Prepare monthly sustainability and utility consumption reports, including KPIs and performance trends. Support energy, water, waste, and carbon reduction initiatives and identify opportunities for operational efficiency. Coordinate sustainability requirements related to LEED, Green Key, ISO standards, and other applicable environmental certifications. Support compliance with Saudi environmental regulations, permits, approvals, and applicable NCEC requirements. Maintain relevant documentation, records, evidence, and action plans required for sustainability audits and certification assessments. Support compliance with DarkSky principles, particularly responsible outdoor lighting, light pollution reduction, and protection of the night-time environment. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree or diploma in Environmental Science, Sustainability, Environmental Engineering, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline. 2–4 years of relevant experience in environmental management, sustainability, or hospitality operations. Exposure to sustainability certifications such as LEED, Green Key, ISO 14001, or similar standards is highly desirable. Knowledge of Saudi environmental regulations and requirements, as well as sustainability practices within the hospitality industry, would be an advantage. Previous experience in a luxury hotel, resort, hospitality environment, or large-scale development project is preferred. Work Type This is a full-time position within the Jumeirah team in Saudi Arabia. Application Process Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply for this role.

d3c6de3a0b9a8b91.description: تقديم صورة مشرفة وفخمة للشركة من خلال استقبال الزوار والعملاء بمهنية عالية، وإدارة الاتصالات الواردة بكفاءة، وضمان انسيابية حركة المراجعين داخل المقر الرئيسي بما يليق بهوية "الماجد للعود". استقبال زوار الشركة (عملاء B2B، مناديب حكوميين، شركاء) والترحيب بهم بأسلوب لائق يعكس كرم الضيافة السعودي وهوية الشركة.التحقق من مواعيد الزوار والتنسيق الفوري مع الإدارات المعنية (مثل مكتب الرئيس التنفيذي للقطاع التجاري أو مديري مبيعات الشركات).الإشراف على نظافة وتنظيم منطقة الاستقبال (Lobby) والتأكد من انبعاث روائح العود الزكية بها بشكل دائم كواجهة للمنتج. الرد على المكالمات الهاتفية الواردة وتحويلها للجهات المختصة بدقة وسرعة.استلام الطرود والبريد الرسمي والوثائق الحكومية وتسجيلها وتوزيعها على الأقسام المعنية.تحديث دليل الهاتف الداخلي للشركة وضمان سهولة الوصول لموظفي الأقسام المختلفة. مراقبة سجل الزوار (تسجيل الدخول والخروج) لضمان النواحي الأمنية والرقابية.المساعدة في حجز قاعات الاجتماعات والتأكد من جاهزيتها من حيث التجهيزات المكتبية والضيافة.إصدار بطاقات الزوار المؤقتة والالتزام بتطبيق سياسات الأمن والسلامة الخاصة بدخول المكاتب.تقديم الدعم الإداري البسيط (مثل تصوير المستندات أو المسح الضوئي) عند الطلب من الإدارة.

d3ab20105e675a31.description: نبحث عن باريستا شغوف ومبدع للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تقديم تجربة قهوة استثنائية لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إعداد مجموعة متنوعة من مشروبات القهوة الفاخرة، والحفاظ على أعلى معايير النظافة والجودة في منطقة العمل. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل ممتازة وحباً للقهوة، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تحضير وتقديم القهوة والمشروبات الأخرى بجودة عالية واهتمام بالتفاصيل. * التعامل مع آلات الإسبريسو ومعدات الباريستا الأخرى بمهارة. * ضمان نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل والمحافظة على مخزون المواد. * تقديم خدمة عملاء ودودة وفعالة، والإجابة على استفسارات الزبائن. * المساهمة في تطوير قائمة المشروبات وتقديم أفكار جديدة.

d328a89924063cbc.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking an Attendant Laundry to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the efficient operation of laundry machinery and maintaining high standards of linen cleanliness. Key Responsibilities Operate and control washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery, including adding necessary chemicals and cleaning lint filters. Identify stained or damaged items and determine the appropriate action, such as stain treatment, rewashing, or discarding. Inspect the cleanliness of items removed from washers, dryers, or dry cleaning machines. Place cleaned items into designated clean linen carts. Program dryer time and temperature according to fabric types to ensure proper care. Remove lint and debris from dryer and dry cleaning machine filters after each load. Fold clean items to the designated size, either manually or using a folding machine. Maintain accurate records of washed and ironed items. Operational Duties and Compliance Comply with all company safety policies and procedures. Report any maintenance issues, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries promptly. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are neat and professional at all times. Maintain the privacy of company proprietary information and protect company assets. Support co-workers and treat them with dignity and respect to foster a collaborative team environment. Meet quality assurance expectations and standards for all tasks performed. Physical Requirements Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than 25 pounds (** kg) without assistance. Capacity to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods or the entire work shift. Visual inspection of tools, equipment, or machines to identify defects. Ability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Capability to move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Ability to navigate over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces and stairs, and ascend/descend stairs and/or service ramps. Qualifications and Experience Education: No high school diploma or equivalent General Educational Development (GED) certificate is required. Related Work Experience: No related work experience is required. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required. License or Certification: None required. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time Attendant Laundry position with Sheraton Hotels & Resorts in Dammam.

d3bb112bcd8f08a4.description: About the Role Daikin Saudi is seeking a Senior Product Engineer DX/VRV to be based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for managing the complete product lifecycle for assigned product lines, from initial market study and specification development through to product launch and ongoing post-launch support. The position requires close collaboration with R&D, Sales, After Sales, Certification, Marketing, and Factory teams to ensure products align with market requirements, regulatory standards, and commercial objectives. Product Development Responsibilities Initiate new product development requests by gathering market intelligence, competitive analysis, sales input, potential volumes, pricing benchmarks, and technical specifications. Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch, including feature prioritization, user research, and after-sales feedback. Conduct detailed technical and market comparison studies against competitors and propose optimized product specifications. Coordinate with Sales and After Sales teams to collect LCQM and field feedback, reporting findings to management. Review and align technical proposals from R&D with market requirements, negotiating specifications as needed. Finalize product specifications and features with regional sales teams before development approval. Propose FOB target prices aligned with product features, capacities, and competitive market positioning. Finalize PPS documentation with R&D to formally initiate product development with factories. Conduct regular follow-ups with R&D teams and provide structured progress updates to management. Support R&D by arranging competitor samples for teardown and benchmarking analysis when required. Coordinate with Certification teams on performance, functional, EMC, CB testing, and labeling requirements in line with regional regulations. Product Support and Compliance Provide technical support to Sales teams and coordinate with factories to ensure timely responses to product-related queries. Maintain a centralized database of technical queries and manage the assigned product portfolio for the sales region. Monitor and manage product lifecycle transitions, communicating timelines to Sales and Service teams. Ensure product compliance with regional regulations and government requirements in coordination with Certification teams. Manage product end-of-life activities due to regulatory changes, ensuring stock liquidation within defined timelines. Update and maintain selection software to support Sales and Application teams with new product ranges. Product Launch Activities Prepare preliminary product catalogs based on initial specifications and data to support early spec-in activities. Develop final sales catalogs including capacity tables, electrical data, features, dimensions, and technical specifications. Coordinate product code creation, material master setup, and pricing uploads in SAP and CRM systems. Prepare product presentations and deliver training sessions to Sales, Application teams, and distributors. Ensure availability of Databooks, IOMs, Service Manuals, and Spare Parts lists in coordination with R&D prior to market launch. Coordinate with Certification teams to ensure all approvals and certifications are completed before product importation. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in product engineering or a similar field, demonstrating a strong understanding of product lifecycle management and technical coordination. The role requires a professional who can effectively manage complex projects and collaborate across multiple departments.

d3b97c1378280c8b.description: About the Role SMART Technology Solutions is seeking an IT Trainee to join our team in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position suitable for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, offering an opportunity to develop practical skills in IT support and infrastructure within a professional environment. Key Responsibilities Provide technical support to end-users. Diagnose and resolve various technical issues. Perform hardware maintenance and follow up on device-related problems. Qualifications and Experience Currently an IT or Computer Science student, or a recent graduate. 0-1 years of relevant experience. Foundational knowledge in hardware, Windows operating systems, and networking basics. Background in cloud infrastructure fundamentals (*, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or OCI). Understanding of infrastructure basics, including servers, storage, and networking. Basic knowledge of laptop maintenance and repair, handling computers and printers, and operating systems. Professional IT certifications are preferred but not mandatory. Required Skills Good IT troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Good command of English, including reading, writing, and communication. Fast learner with strong communication skills. Ability to work effectively within a team. Capability to manage work pressure. Willingness to continuously learn and develop new skills. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within a collaborative team setting at SMART Technology Solutions. The role requires an individual who is eager to contribute and grow within the IT field. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

d39dcd3b66210993.description: About the Role Alrashed Industrial is seeking a Safety Inspector to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time position is responsible for ensuring compliance with safety regulations and company policies to maintain a safe working environment. The role involves active monitoring, hazard identification, and promoting a strong safety culture across operations. Key Responsibilities Conduct routine workplace inspections to identify unsafe acts and conditions. Monitor compliance with company HSE procedures, safety standards, and legal requirements. Perform daily site safety audits and prepare inspection reports. Ensure employees and subcontractors comply with Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) requirements. Report and follow up on safety violations and corrective actions. Participate in incident and accident investigations and prepare reports. Conduct toolbox talks and safety awareness sessions for employees. Assist in preparing risk assessments and job safety analyses (JSA). Maintain safety records, inspection checklists, and documentation. Coordinate emergency response activities and drills when required. Support the implementation of HSE initiatives and continuous improvement programs. Qualifications and Experience Experience required: 0-1 years in a relevant field. Demonstrated understanding of HSE policies, Saudi regulations, and client safety requirements. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah, Makkah, and operates on a full-time schedule within an industrial setting. The Safety Inspector will be actively involved in site inspections and safety monitoring activities. Application Process Candidates interested in this Safety Inspector position at Alrashed Industrial are encouraged to apply.

d3ffc9aca715e1a8.description: :المهام الوظيفية (Responsibilities) .قص وتركيب العدسات وتجميع إطارات النظارات بدقة حسب الوصفات الطبية. إجراء التعديلات والصيانة للنظارات لضمان الراحة وجودة الرؤية. فحص الجودة والتأكد من مطابقة النظارات للمعايير والوصفات. التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم المساعدة في اختيار الإطارات والضبط المناسب. إدارة ومتابعة مخزون العدسات والإطارات والمستلزمات البصرية. المحافظة على الأجهزة والمعدات البصرية ومعايرتها بشكل دوري. :المتطلبات (Requirements) شهادة الثانوية العامة كحد أدنى. خبرة من 2 إلى 5 سنوات كفني بصريات أو مجال مشابه. يشترط وجود شهادة تصنيف مهني سارية كفني بصريات من هيئة التخصصات الصحية السعودية. مهارة عالية في التعامل مع الأجهزة البصرية ودقة في العمل. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على العمل في بيئة سريعة الوتيرة.

d370e47ffa4f9021.description: About the Role Wood (KSA) is seeking an experienced Project Engineering Manager to lead and coordinate small to mid-range projects within the fertilizers (phosphate, ammonia, urea) and mining & metals sectors (aluminum, gold, copper). This full-time, office-based position focuses on engineering oversight, project planning, technical coordination, cost and schedule control, procurement support, and stakeholder alignment. The role manages projects through concept development, feasibility assessment, basic engineering, detailed design oversight, procurement follow-up, and preparation for execution, ensuring all engineering deliverables meet quality, cost, and schedule objectives. This position emphasizes office-driven project leadership with strong coordination between engineering teams, internal departments, and site representatives, and does not involve direct construction management. Occasional short site visits may be required for specific technical reviews. Key Responsibilities Manage P&L with associated commercial and financial accountability, including revenue delivery, margin and overhead management, budget and forecast determination and attainment, risk and opportunity reviews, cost controls, accounts payable/billing, and cash collection. Contribute to and review project proposals and plans to determine timeframe, procedures, staffing requirements, and resource allocation. Contribute to setting project evaluation parameters and negotiate changes to project scope or specifications with customers. Follow the Change Management process to identify and approve modifications to scope, cost, schedule, and quality. Pursue and develop opportunities for innovation, such as digitalization, technology use, work share, and high-value engineering centers. Establish project procedures and lead the production of project execution plans, including scope of work, deliverables list, master schedule, budget, organizational charts, and risk register. Report project progress regularly to senior management and/or customers. Ensure delivery of agreed schedule and financial performance, proactively intervening to avoid slippage. Lead ongoing focus on risk identification and mitigation during project execution. Provide project HSSE leadership, ensuring a program of initiatives and auditing schedule are established, and that HSSE and quality management issues are proactively addressed. Guide and direct a multidiscipline project team, which may include external specialists and staff from multiple offices and sites. Ensure project team members are competent to carry out assigned duties. Promote and establish a performance improvement culture and actions on complex projects and within their supply chains. Facilitate the setup of information management systems/applications as applicable to suit various life phases of projects and manage the information management project team. Participate in assurance activities and peer reviews. Leadership and Ethical Conduct Act as a champion and role model for ethical behavior and compliance with applicable laws and policies. Oversee proposals and call-offs (which may be individual projects) within the delegation of authority, ensuring compliance with contracting policy and standards of ethical conduct. Coach, mentor, and empower others to make decisions within established parameters. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 20 years of experience in project management, specifically within the fertilizers, mining, and metals sectors. Demonstrated experience in leading and coordinating small to mid-range projects. Proven ability to manage projects through concept development, feasibility assessment, basic engineering, and detailed design oversight. Work Type This is a full-time position.

d37c2a52dd3d6d7d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مشاتل العاصمه الحديثه عن مراقب مخزون للانضمام إلى فريقها في الجبيل، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان دقة سجلات المخزون ومراقبة حركة المواد والسلع، مما يساهم في كفاءة العمليات التشغيلية للشركة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مراقبة المخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد سجلات وبطاقات الصنف لجميع السلع والمواد المخزونة. إدخال البيانات المتعلقة بالمواد والسلع المستلمة والمصروفة بدقة. المشاركة في تحديد حد الطلب للمواد والسلع، وإشعار الأطراف المعنية لتجهيز طلبيات الشراء. متابعة ومراقبة تواريخ انتهاء صلاحية المواد والسلع المخزونة. المشاركة في عمليات جرد المخزون ومطابقة الكميات الفعلية مع السجلات والبطاقات. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال مراقبة المخزون أو إدارة المستودعات. القدرة على إعداد السجلات والبطاقات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في إدخال البيانات والتعامل مع أنظمة إدارة المخزون. القدرة على إعداد التقارير وتقديمها بوضوح. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الجبيل بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التزاماً بالعمل ضمن فريق لضمان سير عمليات المخزون بكفاءة وفعالية. ملخص الدور يقوم مراقب المخزون بإدارة وتوثيق حركة المخزون، بدءاً من إعداد السجلات وإدخال البيانات، وصولاً إلى مراقبة حدود الطلب والجرد الدوري. يساهم هذا الدور بشكل مباشر في الحفاظ على دقة المخزون وتوفير المعلومات اللازمة لاتخاذ القرارات التشغيلية.

d3b9c7395185e5cf.description: ممثل مبيعات – بوثات اتصالات نبحث عن ممثلة مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقنا والعمل في بوثات اتصالات داخل الأسواق والمولات. المميزات: راتب أساسي + عمولات مجزية التوظيف في أقرب حي سكني سلم وظيفي وفرص للتطور والترقي تدريب وتأهيل حتى إتقان العمل مكافآت وحوافز للمتميزات وتحقيق الأهداف

d3d1c77c8cf31a84.company_name: مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات
d3d1c77c8cf31a84.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للأبنية المختلفة، وتحديد المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى كيل الأعمال المنجزة وإعداد المطالبات المالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية للأبنية المختلفة وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، بالإضافة إلى إعداد قائمة بالأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل المختلفة، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. كيل الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الهندسية وتفاصيل الصيانة. مهارات جيدة في إعداد قوائم المواد والأدوات والمعدات. القدرة على متابعة فرق العمل ورفع التقارير الفنية. الدقة في كيل وحساب الكميات وإعداد المطالبات المالية. بيئة العمل سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة في مشروع نظافة وصيانة وتشغيل المدينة السكنية بمنفذ عرعر، ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى ضمان جودة وكفاءة أعمال الصيانة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في منطقة الحدود الشمالية، عرعر. المهارات الشخصية مهارات تواصل فعالة للتنسيق مع المهندسين وفرق العمل. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط وإدارة المهام المتعددة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأعمال. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة سليمان محمد عجرم العنزي للمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم للنظر فيها.

d34adb6bf451dc91.description: About the Role Sheraton is seeking a Cook I to join its full-time team. This role involves preparing and cooking food items according to established recipes and quality standards, ensuring proper presentation and adherence to food preparation checklists. The Cook I will also assist in maintaining kitchen operations and supporting the culinary team. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate temperatures of cooking equipment including ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Manage food thawing processes from freezer storage to refrigerator. Ensure correct portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of food items. Maintain accurate food logs and monitor the quality and quantity of prepared food. Communicate staffing needs during peak periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook both hot and cold food items in accordance with recipes and presentation standards. Operational Support and Compliance Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, motivating, and coaching employees, serving as a role model. Adhere to all company and safety and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs, communicating professionally. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, supporting team goals and addressing concerns appropriately. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Capability to reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 years of related work experience is required. No supervisory experience is required for this position. Additional Duties The Cook I will perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors to ensure smooth kitchen operations and guest satisfaction.

d34b9e7788a0922b.description: About Trigo TRIGO is a global leader in providing inspection, quality management, and operational excellence solutions. The company serves demanding industries such as automotive, aerospace, and high-tech sectors. Operating in 28 countries across 4 continents, TRIGO supports clients in continuously improving their industrial performance through recognized expertise, proven methods, and dedicated teams. The Role of Dimensional Engineer TRIGO is seeking a Dimensional Engineer to join its team in Makkah, specifically covering Jeddah and Makkah cities. This full-time role involves taking ownership of dimensional analysis for assigned commodities or shops and coordinating the resolution of dimensional issues. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Review GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing), datum strategy, measurement points, tolerances, build conditions, fixtures, gauges, and dimensional results. Analyze variation and identify contributors from product, process, tooling, fixture, measurement, or assembly. Lead dimensional problem-solving reviews and manage action plans through to closure. Create dashboards and reports to communicate dimensional status, trends, risks, and priorities effectively. Qualifications and Experience A Bachelor's degree (BAC +5) is required. Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar position. Required experience includes automotive BIW (Body-in-White), closures, stamping, or general vehicle dimensional experience. Premium OEM launch experience is preferred. Work Location This full-time position is based in the Makkah region, with work primarily conducted in Jeddah and Makkah cities.

d3523fe9fb77e239.description: About the Role ACWA Power is seeking experienced Mechanical Supervisors for full-time opportunities within RO desalination and CCGT power plants across Saudi Arabia. This role involves supervising preventive, corrective, and condition-based mechanical maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability, safe work execution, and efficient deployment of maintenance personnel during routine operations, planned outages, and overhauls. Key Responsibilities Supervise preventive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance for rotating and static mechanical equipment. Oversee the maintenance of pumps, compressors, valves, piping systems, bearings, seals, and other mechanical equipment. Coordinate mechanical maintenance activities across RO desalination systems or CCGT turbine auxiliaries, cooling-water systems, and balance-of-plant equipment. Lead mechanical technicians in troubleshooting, equipment inspections, repairs, planned outages, and overhauls. Supervise equipment alignment, lubrication, condition monitoring, and mechanical testing to ensure reliable equipment performance. Ensure proper implementation of equipment isolation, permit-to-work requirements, and safe return-to-service procedures. Manage maintenance work orders through CMMS/SAP, review technical drawings and OEM manuals, and coordinate spare parts, tools, and resources. Provide technical guidance, on-the-job training, and performance supervision while ensuring compliance with HSE and quality standards. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical supervision. Demonstrated experience in RO desalination and/or CCGT power plants. Proficiency in managing maintenance work orders using CMMS/SAP. Strong understanding of HSE and quality standards in mechanical maintenance. Work Conditions This is a plant-based position located in Saudi Arabia. The role requires availability to support planned outages, equipment overhauls, and emergency maintenance activities as needed.

d356c0056c11a120.description: About the Role Alesayi Beverages is seeking an Accounting Manager to oversee the company's accounting operations in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves ensuring the accuracy and integrity of financial records, maintaining compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements, and preparing financial reports in a timely manner. The Accounting Manager will supervise general accounting, treasury, tax, and financial reporting activities, contributing to sound financial governance and internal controls. Key Responsibilities Manage and supervise all accounting functions, including general ledger, accounts reconciliation, treasury, tax, and financial reporting activities. Ensure all accounting transactions are accurately recorded in accordance with IFRS, company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements. Review and approve journal entries, account reconciliations, and month-end and year-end closing activities. Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements and management reports within established deadlines. Ensure timely reconciliation of bank accounts, intercompany accounts, and all balance sheet accounts. Supervise treasury activities, including cash management, bank transactions, payment processing, and liquidity monitoring. Oversee tax compliance activities, including VAT, withholding tax, ZATCA requirements, and other statutory filings, ensuring timely and accurate submissions. Coordinate the preparation of schedules and supporting documents for internal and external audits and facilitate audit requirements. Monitor compliance with company financial policies, internal controls, and accounting procedures while identifying opportunities for process improvements. Review accounting records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and proper documentation of financial transactions. Support the Finance Manager in preparing financial analyses, management reports, and recommendations to support strategic decision-making. Lead, coach, and develop the accounting team to enhance performance, technical competency, and compliance with company standards. Coordinate with internal departments to resolve accounting issues and ensure the smooth flow of financial information. Ensure compliance with company policies, applicable laws, financial regulations, and internal control requirements. Participate in ERP and financial system enhancements to improve accounting efficiency and reporting accuracy. Undertake any other duties assigned by the immediate supervisor. Experience and Qualifications Candidates for this position should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in accounting management. A strong understanding of IFRS and regulatory requirements is essential. Skills and Competencies Proficiency in managing all accounting functions, including general ledger, treasury, tax, and financial reporting. Strong analytical skills for financial statement preparation and management reporting. Ability to ensure compliance with accounting standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements. Experience in coordinating internal and external audits. Leadership skills to manage and develop an accounting team. Familiarity with ERP and financial systems for efficiency improvements. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, within the Alesayi Beverages team. The role requires collaboration with various internal departments and active participation in enhancing financial processes. Application Process Further details regarding the application process and salary will be discussed with qualified candidates.

d37a63409351c603.description: About the Role Seara International is seeking a Civil Project Engineer to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves representing the owner’s Projects Management team in executing various factory expansion, construction, facility modification, and building maintenance projects. The position requires 3-5 years of relevant experience. Project Coordination and Oversight The Civil Project Engineer will be responsible for coordinating and monitoring all project disciplines. This includes civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, utilities, and equipment interfaces. The role will involve working with support from consultants and relevant internal technical departments to ensure project objectives are met. Key Responsibilities Represent the owner during project execution and site activities. Coordinate contractors, consultants, suppliers, and internal departments. Monitor multidisciplinary construction activities and project interfaces. Supervise civil, structural, architectural, and finishing works. Coordinate mechanical, electrical, utility, and equipment-related works with relevant technical teams. Review and follow up on drawings, submittals, method statements, quantities, schedules, and technical documents. Monitor progress, quality, safety, cost, schedule, and compliance with project requirements. Identify site constraints, interface issues, risks, delays, and required corrective actions. Prepare progress reports, meeting minutes, action trackers, and project records. Support tendering, technical evaluation, quantity verification, and contractor selection. Follow up on inspections, testing, commissioning, snagging, handover, and project close-out. Coordinate construction activities within or near operating factory areas. Required Experience Candidates should possess 3 to 5 years of experience relevant to civil project engineering and construction management. This experience should ideally include involvement in factory expansion, facility modification, or building maintenance projects. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within an owner’s project management team, coordinating with various internal and external stakeholders in a dynamic project environment. Application Process Seara International invites qualified candidates to apply for this Civil Project Engineer position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d3fa1f49d381156b.description: About the Role Trigo is seeking a Metrology / CMM Programmer to join its automotive activities team. This full-time position is based in Makkah, specifically in Jeddah or Makkah cities, and involves developing, optimizing, maintaining, and revising dimensional measurement programs. The role requires strong practical experience in CMM programming and dimensional inspection. Role Overview The Metrology / CMM Programmer will be responsible for creating and managing measurement programs based on CAD data, engineering drawings, and inspection plans. This involves hands-on work with CMM programming, ensuring accuracy and reliability of measurement routines, and supporting various stages of production from launch to serial inspection. Candidates should have 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Develop, prove-out, optimize, maintain, and revise CMM / dimensional measurement programs using CAD models, drawings, and inspection plans. Perform online and offline CMM programming, adapting to equipment and software configurations. Execute measurement routines and validate dimensional results accurately. Prepare and issue detailed inspection reports. Conduct CAD-to-measurement comparisons and analyze dimensional deviations. Support first-off inspection, launch activities, troubleshooting, and serial production inspection processes. Support CMM program correlation to ensure consistency across different machines, programs, or measurement environments. Improve the repeatability and reproducibility of measurement routines. Optimize measurement strategies to enhance accuracy, reliability, and cycle time. Identify and support the reduction of inspection bottlenecks. Support dimensional issue investigation in collaboration with Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Dimensional teams. Maintain and update measurement programs following product, process, tooling, or engineering changes. Ensure measurement routines and inspection methods comply with drawing, GD&T, and customer requirements. Required Experience and Skills 0-1 years of experience in CMM programming and dimensional inspection. Strong hands-on experience in CMM programming. Proficiency in dimensional inspection and measurement strategy. Ability to perform CAD-to-measurement comparison effectively. Work Environment and Benefits Trigo offers a stimulating industrial environment with safe working conditions. The company is committed to supporting the development of its employees' skills. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the hiring process.

d301558ec193eff7.description: مستشارة عطور في مجموعة شلهوب تبحث مجموعة شلهوب، الشريك الرائد في قطاع السلع الكمالية في الشرق الأوسط، عن مستشارة عطور للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. نبذة عن مجموعة شلهوب تتمتع مجموعة شلهوب بخبرة تتجاوز 65 عامًا في المنطقة، وتدير أكثر من 600 متجر و300 علامة تجارية. تعمل المجموعة على التحول إلى مؤسسة تجارية هجينة للبيع بالتجزئة، وتهدف إلى بناء فريق عمل عالمي المستوى وتوظيف التكنولوجيا والبيانات لدعم نموها المستمر في قطاعات الجمال والموضة والهدايا. المهام والمسؤوليات تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة واستخدام أساليب المبيعات المناسبة لتحقيق الأهداف. الحفاظ على نظافة المنضدة وإعادة التموين. التعامل مع إطلاق المنتجات الجديدة وعروض المنتجات والتسويق. تطوير معايير تجربة الضيوف والحفاظ عليها لتعزيز ولاء العملاء. الإجابة على استفسارات العملاء حول المنتجات والأسعار والتوافر والاستخدامات. التواصل مع العملاء لتقييم احتياجاتهم وتقديم المساعدة. إحاطة العملاء بنطاقات المنتجات الأنسب لاحتياجاتهم. توضيح استخدامات العلامات التجارية والمنتجات المختلفة ومزاياها. تعزيز المبيعات وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. متابعة الأهداف على مستوى المتاجر وإعداد تقارير المبيعات اليومية. المشاركة في تحقيق الحوافز ومتابعة أهداف البيع بعد إطلاق المنتج الجديد. التأكد من تحقيق مستويات التسويق في المتجر وفقًا لتوجيهات العلامة التجارية. التأكد من إعادة تموين المتاجر في الرفوف المناسبة وفي الأوقات المناسبة. رفع التقارير بنقص المخزون باستخدام نموذج طلب المخزون. التأكد من استلام المخزون وفقًا للإجراءات الموضوعة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2-5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تقديم خدمة عملاء مميزة. معرفة جيدة بالمنتجات وأساليب المبيعات. مهارات تواصل فعالة. ما تقدمه مجموعة شلهوب تلتزم مجموعة شلهوب بدعم تطور موظفيها من خلال توفير فرص التعلم والتطوير والتعامل مع مهام متنوعة. تقدم المجموعة حزمة مزايا تنافسية تشمل الرعاية الصحية، والمساهمة في تعليم الأطفال، وسياسات عمل عن بعد ومرنة، بالإضافة إلى خصومات حصرية للموظفين. ترحب المجموعة بجميع المرشحين وتلتزم بمبادئ الشمول والتنوع في جميع عملياتها.

d3878c4ded82c233.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Petroleum Company is seeking an Internal Audit Manager to lead and manage the regional internal audit function. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern region, and is crucial for ensuring effective risk management, internal control, and governance processes across the organization. Role Purpose and Impact The Internal Audit Manager will be responsible for planning, executing, and reporting on audit engagements. The role involves providing value-added recommendations and ensuring compliance with professional standards and regulatory requirements, contributing directly to the organization's operational integrity and strategic objectives. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement a risk-based annual audit plan aligned with organizational strategic objectives. Assess key business risks, internal controls, and compliance with laws and regulations. Lead and supervise audit engagements from planning through reporting stages, ensuring adequate documentation and achievement of audit objectives. Conduct complex audits independently and provide technical guidance to audit staff. Evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and risk management processes. Prepare and present clear and concise audit reports to management and the Audit Committee. Communicate audit findings, risks, and recommendations professionally and constructively. Monitor and follow up on the implementation of audit recommendations. Mentor and develop junior auditors, fostering continuous learning and professional growth within the audit function. Stay informed about emerging risks, audit standards, and regulatory changes, ensuring compliance with IIA Standards and relevant professional frameworks. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 7 to 10 years of relevant experience in internal audit. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage audit engagements effectively. Strong understanding of risk management, internal control, and governance processes. Proficiency in preparing and presenting audit reports. Professional Development The role involves fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement within the audit function. The Internal Audit Manager will recommend process improvements and contribute to the enhancement of governance and risk management frameworks. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

d342ac51b8acc94a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السفير لنقل الحجاج والمعتمرين عن سائق شاحنة صغيرة للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان نقل آمن وفعال وفقًا للخطط الموضوعة والمعايير المتبعة، مع الالتزام التام بقواعد السلامة المرورية والتشغيلية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تشغيل وقيادة الشاحنة الصغيرة بمهارة، والالتزام بالمسارات المحددة وخطط العمل المعتمدة. التقيد الصارم بجميع قواعد المرور وأنظمة الأمن والسلامة، وتجنب ارتكاب أي مخالفات نظامية. إجراء فحوصات دورية ومنتظمة للشاحنة للتحقق من سلامتها وجاهزيتها للعمل. معالجة المشكلات والأعطال البسيطة التي قد تطرأ على الشاحنة بشكل فوري وفعال. رفع طلبات الصيانة اللازمة للخبراء المختصين عند ملاحظة أي أعطال تتطلب تدخلًا فنيًا. الالتزام التام بجميع أدلة الإجراءات، وأدلة المواصفات والمعايير، وسياسات وقواعد السلامة العامة المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في قيادة الشاحنات الصغيرة أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على الالتزام بالتعليمات والمسارات المحددة. معرفة جيدة بقواعد المرور وأنظمة السلامة. القدرة على إجراء فحوصات أساسية للمركبة وتحديد المشكلات البسيطة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور العمل ضمن فريق ملتزم بتقديم خدمات نقل عالية الجودة للحجاج والمعتمرين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة في شركة السفير لنقل الحجاج والمعتمرين.

d3c36028dc25d4be.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سما المنار للمقاولات والتجارة عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إصلاحها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قوائم تفصيلية ببنود القطع والمواد والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. متابعة سير العمل في تنفيذ شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات. تشخيص الأعطال التي قد تصيب المعدات الميكانيكية ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها بفعالية. الإشراف على تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات لضمان استمرارية عملها وكفاءتها. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة والغاز أو صيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات بدقة. مهارات جيدة في تشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة ضمن فريق شركة سما المنار للمقاولات والتجارة. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع العمل لمتابعة تنفيذ المشاريع وصيانة المعدات. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص في مجال المقاولات والتجارة، حيث يمكن للمرشح تطوير مهاراته في بيئة عمل داعمة. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

d3d02f9b3d667e07.description: About the Role Starlinks is seeking a Mid-Level QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, functionality, and performance of its technology platforms. This full-time role involves systematic testing and quality assurance practices, focusing on designing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and validating system integrations. The Mid-Level QA Engineer will collaborate with various cross-functional teams to deliver stable, secure, and high-quality software solutions aligned with Starlinks’ business objectives. Key Responsibilities Analyze business requirements and technical documentation to define testing needs and scenarios. Develop, review, and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test data. Perform functional, regression, integration, system, exploratory, and end-to-end testing. Validate application workflows, business rules, and data processing across backend services, APIs, and user interfaces. Execute manual and automated tests according to established QA processes and project timelines. Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using issue-tracking tools such as Jira. Collaborate with developers to investigate, reproduce, and verify reported defects. Perform API testing using tools like Postman to validate endpoints, payloads, and error handling. Test integrations between internal systems, external services, databases, and third-party platforms. Perform database validation using SQL queries to verify data accuracy and consistency. Support performance and load testing using tools such as JMeter when required. Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, and defect triage. Maintain clear and accurate documentation of test results, defects, and quality metrics. Additional Duties Support QA activities during deployments, release validation, and production issue investigations. Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and assist business stakeholders in validating functionalities. Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of automated test suites and regression testing processes. Support continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows by validating automated test results. Ensure testing activities comply with established quality standards, security requirements, and project procedures. Required Experience 3-5 years of experience in Quality Assurance or a related field. Collaboration and Improvement The Mid-Level QA Engineer will work closely with developers, DevOps, product owners, and business analysts to ensure comprehensive test coverage. This role involves translating functional and technical requirements into clear test scenarios and measurable acceptance criteria, and identifying opportunities to improve test coverage, testing efficiency, and overall software quality. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

d3d951c0d9a0160a.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث مؤسسة بدر الحميدي الجديعي العتيبي للصيانه والتشغيل عن ميكانيكي مصاعد للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية فحص وصيانة وتصليح المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة والمقاعد الهوائية والأرصفة المتحركة، مما يضمن سلامتها وكفاءتها التشغيلية. هذه فرصة بدوام كامل تتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء عمليات التفتيش الروتينية كجزء من الصيانة الوقائية، وتحديد الأضرار التي قد تلحق بالمعدات. تصليح واستبدال الأجزاء التالفة أو المعطوبة، واختبار المعدات بعد إتمام التصليح لضمان عملها الصحيح. تفكيك المعدات لإجراء التحسينات الأساسية وإعادة تجميعها، وتوفير الأجزاء المطلوبة لعمليات الصيانة والتصليح. حفظ السجلات الدقيقة لجميع خدمات المعدات وعمليات التصليح التي تم إجراؤها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال صيانة وتصليح المصاعد أو ما شابهها. القدرة على فحص وتشخيص الأعطال في المصاعد والسلالم المتحركة. مهارات جيدة في التصليح الميكانيكي واستبدال الأجزاء. بيئة العمل يعمل ميكانيكي المصاعد ضمن فريق في مدينة الرياض، في وظيفة بدوام كامل. تتطلب الوظيفة الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات فنية قوية في الميكانيكا. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. الالتزام بالدقة والجودة في العمل. القدرة على اتباع الإرشادات والتعليمات الفنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مؤسسة بدر الحميدي الجديعي العتيبي للصيانه والتشغيل، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب لهذه الوظيفة.

d31344b5cf095312.description: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced IBM Cognos Analytics Developer to design, develop, and maintain enterprise reports, dashboards, and analytics solutions using IBM Cognos Analytics. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in developing complex reports and interactive dashboards based on customer requirements, working with data models and cubes, and integrating Cognos content with IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) and 3D Dashboard solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for delivering high-quality business intelligence solutions that enable data-driven decision-making through advanced reporting, analytics, and visualization. Key Responsibilities Gather and analyze business requirements from customers and translate them into reporting and analytics solutions. Design, develop, and maintain complex operational, analytical, and executive reports using IBM Cognos Analytics. Develop interactive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and self-service analytics to meet customer requirements. Design and implement drill-down, drill-through, and parameterized reports. Develop and maintain multidimensional data models, Framework Manager models, and data modules. Design, build, and optimize OLAP cubes and data cubes for high-performance analytics and reporting. Develop advanced calculations, metrics, prompts, filters, and custom expressions. Integrate IBM Cognos Analytics with IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS), enterprise databases, and third-party applications. Support the development and integration of Cognos reports and dashboards with IBM Maximo 3D Dashboard capabilities and visualization solutions. Optimize report performance and troubleshoot complex reporting issues. Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions. Develop reusable reporting templates and dashboard components. Collaborate with business users, solution architects, and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle. Prepare technical documentation, user guides, and knowledge transfer materials. Provide production support, enhancements, and performance tuning for Cognos environments. Required Technical Skills IBM Technologies IBM Cognos Analytics IBM Cognos Report Studio / Reporting IBM Cognos Dashboard IBM Framework Manager IBM Cognos Data Modules IBM Cognos Event Studio (preferred) IBM Cognos Administration Reporting & Analytics Complex Report Development Executive Dashboards KPI Dashboards Drill-through Reports Scheduled Reports Bursting Reports Data Visualization Analytical Reporting Data & Database Skills SQL (Advanced) Data Modeling OLAP Cubes Data Cubes Star Schema and Snowflake Schema ETL concepts Performance Tuning Database Experience IBM Db2 Oracle Microsoft SQL Server PostgreSQL Other enterprise relational databases Integration Skills REST APIs JDBC/ODBC IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS) TNCP Performance Dashbaord. 3D Dashboard Integration Enterprise data integration concepts Required Experience 5+ years of hands-on experience with IBM Cognos Analytics. Proven experience developing complex reports and dashboards for enterprise customers. Strong experience with Framework Manager and metadata modeling. Experience designing and maintaining OLAP/data cubes for analytical reporting. Experience integrating Cognos with enterprise applications, including IBM Maximo Application Suite. Strong SQL development and query optimization skills. Experience with performance tuning of reports and dashboards. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable reporting solutions. Preferred Qualifications IBM Cognos Analytics Certification. Experience with IBM Maximo Application Suite (MAS). Experience developing dashboards for IBM Maximo Monitor or IBM Maximo Visual Inspection. Knowledge of data warehousing and business intelligence best practices. Experience with OpenShift and cloud-based deployments. Familiarity with Python or scripting for automation is an advantage. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Ability to interact directly with customers and gather reporting requirements. Strong documentation and solution design capabilities. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross-functional teams. Customer-focused mindset with the ability to deliver high-quality analytics solutions within project timelines. Education Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Preferred Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in IBM Cognos Analytics, with the ability to develop sophisticated reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions tailored to customer requirements. The candidate should be proficient in building and optimizing data models and cubes, integrating Cognos with IBM Maximo Application Suite and 3D Dashboard environments, and delivering scalable, high-performance business intelligence solutions that support operational and executive decision-making.

d31f4621664e7955.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث Namaa Partners عن محلل أداء للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يعمل محلل الأداء بشكل وثيق مع الشركاء لتحليل بيانات العملاء وتحويلها إلى رؤى واضحة تدعم اتخاذ القرار. يشمل الدور التعامل مع مجموعة واسعة من البيانات، بدءًا من قوائم المبيعات وتقارير التشغيل وصولاً إلى نماذج التكاليف والموازنات، بهدف تقديم قراءات وتحليلات يمكن عرضها والدفاع عنها أمام مجالس الإدارة أو الشركاء في المجموعات العائلية. عن Namaa Partners Namaa Partners هي شركة استشارات استراتيجية تركز على العمل مع الجهات والشركات ذات المصالح الكبيرة في المملكة العربية السعودية. تغطي خدمات الشركة مجالات متعددة تشمل استراتيجية الشركات، النمو، دخول الأسواق، تصميم النماذج التشغيلية، كفاءة التشغيل، التنظيم، الموارد البشرية، الاستراتيجية الرقمية، تحسين الأداء، الحوكمة، وإدارة المخاطر. تشمل قاعدة عملائها المجموعات العائلية وشركاتها القابضة، الشركات المدرجة، شركات المحافظ في صناديق الملكية الخاصة، البنوك، شركات التأمين، والجهات الحكومية والمنشآت الصناعية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع بيانات العملاء وتنظيمها في ملفات عمل واضحة، مع التحقق من صحة الأرقام ومصادرها قبل استخدامها في أي تحليل. بناء نماذج مالية وتشغيلية بسيطة لمقارنة الأداء بين الفروع أو الوحدات أو السنوات، وتحديد الفجوات المحتملة وأسبابها. إعداد شرائح وعروض تنفيذية تعرض النتائج للشركاء قبل الاجتماعات مع العملاء، وتعديلها بناءً على الملاحظات. حضور بعض اجتماعات الفريق مع العملاء لتدوين الملاحظات والأسئلة التي تتطلب متابعة أو بيانات إضافية. متابعة مؤشرات الأداء بعد بدء التنفيذ وتحديث الملفات بشكل دوري لتوضيح التحسينات والتحديات المستمرة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ودائمة، وتتيح العمل عن بعد مع وجود مقر للشركة في الرياض. ما تقدمه الشركة فرصة عمل دائمة بدوام كامل مع إمكانية العمل عن بعد، ومقر الشركة في الرياض. التعرض المباشر لعملية بناء الاستشارات، من تحديد نطاق العمل الأولي إلى تقديم العروض النهائية أمام مجالس الإدارة. التعامل المباشر مع بيانات وأرقام عملاء من قطاعات متنوعة في المملكة، تشمل مجموعات عائلية، شركات مدرجة، وجهات حكومية. العمل مع الشركاء لفهم كيفية قراءة النموذج التشغيلي قبل صياغة التوصيات. المهارات والكفاءات المطلوبة للنجاح القدرة على العمل بتركيز على البيانات لفترات طويلة قبل الوصول إلى النتائج، مع الاستمتاع بترتيب الأرقام لجعلها مفهومة. مهارات كتابة موجزة وواضحة، مع مراجعة دقيقة للمحتوى قبل الإرسال، والتحقق من مصادر الأرقام بدلاً من الافتراض. المرونة في قبول الملاحظات وتعديل العروض التقديمية بسرعة بعد مراجعة الشركاء. القدرة على إدارة ملفات متعددة في وقت واحد مع تحديد أولويات واضحة لضمان إنجاز العمل بفعالية.

d3d5b77d4fddd69d.description: About Baker Hughes Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company that serves the energy sector across more than 120 countries. The Operations (ARMO) team supports customers through equipment maintenance, repair, and operational excellence. The company combines technical expertise with strong safety practices to ensure reliable equipment performance and exceptional customer support. Role Overview Baker Hughes is seeking an Assembly Repair Maintenance & Overhaul Mechanic to join its team in Al-Ahsa, Al-Ahsa Governorate, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves troubleshooting, testing, assembling, disassembling, and performing visual inspections of mechanical assemblies. The ARMO Mechanic will assist in repairing and modifying non-conforming equipment and conduct complex tests with minimal instruction. The position also requires providing technical support across the business while adhering to HS&E policies. Key Responsibilities Perform routine preventative and corrective maintenance on coiled tubing units, injectors, reels, trailers, power packs, and fluid pumps. Diagnose and repair mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and diesel engine issues to ensure maximum reliability during well operations. Maintain, test, and assemble products, tools, and sub-assemblies for operations. Work according to pre-defined procedures in line with established work practices. Assist in reworking, repairing, and modifying non-conforming equipment. Provide coaching to other technicians in areas of proven competence. Handle special projects as assigned. Ensure compliance with HS&E policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and diesel engine issues. Proficiency in performing complex tests with minimal supervision. Strong understanding and adherence to HS&E policies and procedures. Work Conditions This position operates on a shift-based working pattern with opportunities for overtime. Candidates may be required to remain on call after hours and during weekends on a rotating schedule. Specific working schedules can be discussed during the application process. About Our Culture Baker Hughes values its workforce and invests in the health and well-being of its employees. The company is committed to developing talent and fostering leaders at all levels. Baker Hughes encourages an environment where individuals can bring their authentic selves to work and contribute to continuous innovation in the energy sector.

d3b749fca34df7a8.job_title: Step Up Your Pastry Career: Junior Pastry Sous Chef - Al Khobar
d3b749fca34df7a8.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Head Chef / Head Pastry Chef) Compensation: 7,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are exclusively partnering with an exquisite, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven pastry professional to bring quiet excellence and creativity to their pastry section. The Role As a Junior Pastry Sous Chef, you will support the Head Pastry Chef in managing the pastry section. You will take ownership of daily production—ranging from delicate viennoiserie to refined plated desserts—while maintaining uncompromising quality, developing the junior team, and confidently stepping up to lead the section when needed. Your Profile & Experience Experience: 3 to 5 years of dedicated pastry experience, with at least 2 to 3 years serving as a Chef de Partie Pastry or senior pastry cook within a fine dining or upscale restaurant setting. Technical Foundation: Deep, hands-on knowledge of viennoiserie, doughs, creams, chocolate work, and fillings, alongside a strict understanding of shelf life, storage protocols, and allergen controls. Traits: Precise, creative, and quietly excellent. You are cost-aware and focused on consistency. Language: English fluency is mandatory. Additional skills in French or another European language are highly advantageous. Core Responsibilities Pastry Techniques: Execute classic and contemporary pastry techniques with precision, care, and a highly refined eye for presentation. Leadership & Mentoring: Actively participate in motivating and developing the pastry team, maintain discipline during busy services, and lead the section with confidence in the Head Pastry Chef's absence. Production & Storage: Plan daily production, rigorously monitor shelf life, maintain strict FIFO and labeling standards, and flawlessly execute freezing and defrosting procedures. Hygiene & Quality: Ensure every item leaving the section meets strict standards for taste, texture, and visual appeal while keeping the workspace clean, safe, and fully compliant. Cost & Inventory Control: Monitor stock levels, manage portion controls, and minimize waste, ensuring premium quality is maintained without losing sight of food costs.

d30326f91a8f9610.description: Your mission: The Consumer & Channel Sales Manager provides operational management of the Consumer Sales team in Saudi Arabia. They will be responsible for the achievement of quantitative and qualitative objectives of the team and provide specialist knowledge to both the sales team and KSA customers. What you will do: Sales strategy and business growth Develop and execute the annual consumer sales strategy in line with Saudi Arabia's business plan and regional objectives. Achieve annual, quarterly, and monthly sales targets, including revenue, volume, and profitability. Identify opportunities to grow the consumer printing business, particularly EcoTank and other home and small-office printing solutions. Develop growth plans by channel, customer, product category, and geographical region. Monitor market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and consumer demand to identify new opportunities. Channel and distribution management Develop and manage relationships with distributors, master resellers, T2 partners, retail chains, and independent retailers. Expand the active partner base and improve productivity among existing partners. Identify new partners and reduce overdependence on a limited number of distributors or customers. Establish clear sales targets, account plans, joint business plans (JBPs), and performance reviews for key partners. Ensure healthy channel inventory, appropriate stock availability, and sustainable partner profitability. Monitor partner performance and implement corrective actions where targets are not being achieved. Retail execution and sell-out development Drive consumer sell-out across key retail accounts and independent retail channels. Develop retail activation plans, promotional campaigns, product displays, and in-store visibility. Ensure effective product positioning, pricing compliance, merchandising, and availability across priority outlets. Work with retail account managers, promoters, and merchandisers to improve conversion and product recommendation. Conduct regular market visits across Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and other priority cities. Track retail inventory and ageing to minimize excess stock, stock-outs, and channel loading. E-commerce and omnichannel development Develop consumer sales through online retailers, marketplaces, and distributors' e-commerce platforms. Work closely with the online sales and marketing teams to improve product visibility, assortment, conversion, and promotional execution. Ensure accurate product listings, competitive pricing, and availability across online channels. Identify opportunities to expand Epson's consumer portfolio and increase online revenue contribution. Forecasting, reporting, and commercial discipline Prepare accurate sales forecasts and maintain regular visibility of sell-in, sell-out, inventory, and pipeline performance. Review performance against the agreed business forecast, identifying risks and recovery actions early. Maintain accurate sales reporting and partner information in the designated CRM or sales management system. Monitor sales by customer, product, channel, and region to identify growth opportunities and underperformance. Manage commercial investments, rebates, promotional budgets, and partner incentives in line with agreed policies. Ensure sales growth is achieved without compromising margin, channel health, or commercial compliance. Cross-functional collaboration Work closely with marketing to develop consumer campaigns, product launches, and retail activation programs. Coordinate with supply chain and distribution teams to secure stock availability and prioritize high-demand products. Collaborate with business units on product strategy, pricing, promotions, and new product introductions. Share market intelligence and competitor insights with regional management. Align with service and technical teams to ensure appropriate consumer support and customer satisfaction. Leadership and capability development Lead, coach, and develop the consumer sales team and relevant field resources. Set clear individual objectives, KPIs, and performance expectations. Develop the capabilities of channel account managers and retail-facing teams through structured coaching and training. Promote accountability, ownership, disciplined execution, and cross-functional teamwork. What we ask for: Experience of, or acceptance of working in a matrix organisation and use of centrally resourced functions. 2-3 years+ experience in a sales leadership or team management role. Strong knowledge of the Saudi consumer electronics and/or IT hardware landscape. Experience working for a multinational organisation is preferred. Strong commercial negotiation, account management, and business planning capabilities A track record of sales results demonstrating customer portfolio growth. Good record of academic achievement. Fluent in Arabic and professional level spoken and written English skills. What we offer: Our benefits In return, we offer a competitive salary and a wide range of excellent benefits, including a working environment where quality, teamwork, and respect come first. Our heritage We aspire to be an indispensable company, trusted throughout the world for our commitment to openness, customer satisfaction and sustainability. We respect individuality while promoting teamwork, and we are committed to delivering unique value through innovative and creative solutions. Our commitment to the environment We all have a role to play in building a better future. For Epson, being a sustainable company means being mindful of every aspect of our organisation – from the smallest lightbulb to the largest factory. It fuels our innovation, drives our growth, motivates our workforce and, ultimately, to contribute to society. Our people We believe a healthy culture, strong values, teamwork and contribution from a diverse range of individuals will help us to strive for excellence. Our brand Ranked by Clarivate Analytics as a Top 100 Global Innovator brand for the last seven years running.

d3651e2e682bd7f1.description: Job description At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position The Marketing & Omnichannel Enabler - Multiple Sclerosis for the Middle East is responsible for shaping and executing customer- and patient-centric commercial strategies, including marketing, brand, and customer engagement, for the assigned disease area across the Middle East. This role connects brand ambition with customer experience - integrating market insights, omnichannel engagement, and product strategies to deliver impactful, insights-driven, and patient-centered outcomes. This role operates 80% for the ME countries, working closely with Disease Area Squads, ME affiliate POCs, Disease Commercialization Leader (DCL), Patient Journey Partners (PJPs), Medical, Access, and Informatics to co-create meaningful experiences and drive commercial success. The remaining 20% will stay within the local Affiliate or Chapter to maintain flexibility and relevance at the local level. Your Responsibilities Marketing Strategy, business planning, and launch readiness Partner closely with DCL and respective Disease Area Squad to implement global brand and portfolio strategies(DACS & CORP), ensuring alignment with business outcomes and patient needs Conduct market analysis and competitive landscaping to inform brand positioning and market opportunities. Lead execution of global segmentation, targeting, and positioning strategies, crafting compelling value propositions for healthcare solutions. Work closely with DCL and ME affiliates to support launch readiness planning, tactical execution, and performance tracking for Malignant Hematology and relevant initiatives. Lead the localization and execution of global communication strategies for campaigns, events, and content assets, ensuring scientific accuracy and market relevance. Shape and contribute to across-affiliate DA financial ambition, ensuring optimal investment planning in collaboration with affiliate teams, finance & DCL. Customer Experience & Omnichannel Engagement Design and execute disease area specific promotional plans and integrated customer experiences by leveraging customer segmentation, persona development, and personalized targeting in collaboration with PJPs and customer facing teams. Identification and management of compelling and modular content needs (promotional & non promotional) that is tailored for different audiences, channels, and formats in close collaboration with internal and external partners, adhering to brand guidelines, compliance/regulatory requirements, and MLR processes.
